summary: INOVIO PHARMACEUTICALS, INC. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten offering of common stock and warrants (or pre-funded warrants). The combined public offering price per share-and-warrant unit is not yet fixed; the warrants have a five-year term and an exercise price to be set. The company, a smaller reporting company, is raising capital via Piper Sandler as sole manager, with a 30-day over-allotment option. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No special-situation premium, activist involvement, or strategic change is present. Watch for pricing dynamics, but no arbitrage angle applies.
